# Sameer Goel

> AI Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, trainer, speaker, and author based in the Netherlands. He helps purpose-driven founders turn ambitious AI ideas into buildable products and market experiments, and has shipped 28 live AI solutions across autonomous agents, AI education, wellbeing, sustainability, cognition, and consciousness.

Roles: AI Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), AI Educator, Trainer, Speaker, Author.
Expertise: agentic AI, AI agents, generative AI, machine learning, AWS cloud architecture, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Rekognition, computer vision, prompt engineering, responsible AI, AI literacy, mindful technology.
Speaking: AWS re:Invent (Las Vegas), AWS Summit Stockholm, AWS Summit New York, university panels, corporate hackathons, mindfulness and breathwork sessions.
Publishing: AWS Machine Learning Blog and AWS Architecture Blog, plus essays on human cognition and mindful use of AI.
Contact: https://cal.com/sameer-goel/collab

- [Portfolio homepage](https://sameer-goel.com/): Public speaking, thought leadership, 28 shipped AI solutions, and the book.

## Autonomous AI and agents

- [Learn Agent Workflows](https://learnagentworkflows.pages.dev/): Course on designing and running AI agent workflows.
- [Web4Agents](https://sameer-goel.github.io/web4agents/): Framework for an agent-native web.
- [SAaaS](https://sameer-goel.github.io/innovative-solutions/Autonomous-AI/saaas/): Solution architecture as a service, driven by autonomous agents.
- [AI Hackathon Arena](https://ai-pool.netlify.app/): Multi-model arena for hackathon-style AI competition.
- [Build a Completely Sovereign AI System](https://sameer-goel.github.io/Build-Completely-Sovereign-AI-System/): Seven-level curriculum to reverse-engineer an AI coding agent and build a fully local one with Python and Ollama.
- [Digital Consciousness](https://sameerai.com): Explorations at the boundary of AI and consciousness.
